Overview.Name: Sangeetha Sitamraju
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Early_Morning (optional): Option 1: Warm water (200 ml) + soaked fenugreek seeds (1 tsp)
Option 2: Warm water (200 ml) + soaked almonds (6 nos)
Option 3: Warm water (200 ml) + fruit (100 g)
Breakfast: Option 1: Vegetable upma (80 g) with mixed vegetables (60 g) + curd (100 g)
Option 2: Rawa dosa (2 small) + sambar (150 g)
Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (150 g) + dal (150 g) + paneer curry (120 g) + salad (50 g)
Option 2: Millet khichdi (200 g) with vegetables (100 g) + curd (100 g)
Option 3: Chapati (2) + mixed vegetable curry (150 g) + dal (100 g)
Evening_Snack: Option 1: Roasted makhana (30 g) + green tea (200 ml)
Option 2: Fruit (100 g) + handful of nuts (20 g)
Dinner: Option 1: Dal (180 g) + vegetable curry (150 g) + salad (50 g)
Option 2: Paneer bhurji (120 g) + chapati (1) + lightly cooked veggies (100 g)
Option 3: Light vegetable soup (250 ml) + millet roti (2 small)

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid soy and seafood; rely on paneer, dal, and nuts for protein.
Control portion sizes of rice and fried snacks to manage weight.
When cravings start, have a small portion of nuts or fruit.
Aim for a consistent sleep schedule to reduce late-night cravings.
Include light daily exercise like walking or yoga for mood and metabolism.
Prepare simple, familiar meals to stay consistent with the plan.
